policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV temporal 'when he opened' can render either ὅταν with its subjunctive or ὅτε with its indicative.
ASV 'that he should add it' directly reflects the subjunctive δώσῃ under ἵνα rather than future indicative δώσει.
ASV reflexive 'themselves' excludes simple personal αὐτούς but does not distinguish the reflexive spellings αὑτούς and ἑαυτούς; retain the base fallback.
ASV explicitly has 'burning with fire,' requiring πυρί and excluding its omission.
ASV 'the creatures' may supply a definite article in English whether or not Greek τῶν is present.
ASV singular 'the third part of the ships was destroyed' directly reflects διεφθάρη rather than plural διεφθάρησαν.
ASV omits an English article before the predicate proper name 'Wormwood,' as it normally would whether Greek ὁ is present or absent.
ASV preserves the base order 'the day should not shine for the third part of it'; the alternative fronts 'the third part of it' before the verb and subject.
ASV 'Woe ... for them that dwell' reflects the accusative τοὺς κατοικοῦντας governed by ἐπί, rather than the dative alternative.
